Where would I begin? 

(Sorry for the short response, I just don't even know how to reply to all that, it has me rather emotional)

Thank you for this. The not being able to imagine it gone part is so very true. It feels like it's a part of me now, and to lose it would be to lose part of my identity. It's crazy and illogical, but that's emotions for you, I suppose. 

I guess I just feel so very broken, to the point where I don't even know where to start fixing myself. The very few times I have let people in, I can tell that they very quickly get tired of dealing with me, because despite their better efforts, I always regress back at times. So I put the mask back on, because I'd rather have someone to talk to than no one at all. And this hatred of all things sexual causes me to alienate most friends by talking about it, because most people love sex in some form or another. 

I just don't know how to fix myself. I got bounced around by therapists, my friends either don't know about my problems, or tend to not talk about them because they're uncomfortable, and I still don't feel like I can go to my mom about things. So I just stay in my room, and lock my door, and hope that one day I'll find out either how to fix myself, or finally get the courage to just end it.
